approach: Add `Mistake` to InterventionCategory (ALL becomes 9, as_str "mistake") and one shared predicate `Intervention::is_mistake()` in records.rs: category is mistake, or category is other and `what` starts with "Mistake:" (documented in a doc comment; records untouched). In status.rs add a `MistakeReport` built from store::Records: total, counts per class_of_work, counts per cause. Cause is the failure-class name of the mistake's introspection (existing field); mistakes without an introspection count under "not yet introspected". Each cause entry carries the prevention proposed (prevention_kind, prevention, proposed_request from the newest introspection of that cause), so repeat causes collapse into one entry and one proposal. StatusView gets a separate `mistakes` JSON, leaving `interventions_by_category` raw. Introspection: event_of_intervention maps is_mistake records to category "mistake"; user_prompt adds an instruction for mistakes to name the preventing check or knowledge in `prevention` and to state the cause as a recurring class. `athena audit` prints and emits the same report (main.rs, display.rs). Criterion 5 is shown by the fmt and clippy commands, which fail on any unformatted or warning-producing code introduced by the change.

decisions.choice: Derive cause from the mistake's introspection failure class, not a new Intervention field
decisions.reason: Class names are stable keys so repeats aggregate; Intervention has deny_unknown_fields and is immutable, so a new field would break old records.

rejected.option: Add a cause field to Intervention
rejected.why: Schema change; the eleven back-filled records could not carry it.
Prose rarely repeats exactly, so nothing aggregates.

decisions.choice: One is_mistake() predicate (category mistake, or other with 'Mistake:' prefix) used by status, audit and introspection
decisions.reason: Fixes the root cause (mislabelled back-filled records) without rewriting records; one definition.

rejected.why: Out of scope; records are immutable.

decisions.choice: Keep interventions_by_category raw; add a separate mistakes object

rejected.option: Fold prefix-marked records into the mistake key
rejected.why: Hides stored category and double-defines the count.

decisions.choice: Aggregate repeat-cause prevention inside the mistake report, not proposals.rs
decisions.reason: proposals.rs needs 3 distinct jobs and ignores job-less cases; operator mistakes often have no job. It is not a deliverable.

rejected.why: Not a deliverable; touches defaults flow.

decisions.choice: Audit surface is `athena audit` output carrying the same MistakeReport
decisions.reason: It is the only audit command; counts come from code, not the model.

rejected.why: Would need the model to count.

files.purpose: Add Mistake variant, ALL of 9, as_str; documented Intervention::is_mistake() with the prefix rule; unit tests.
MistakeReport (total, by_class, by_cause with prevention), builder, `mistakes` in StatusView, method for audit; unit test.
Map mistakes to category 'mistake'; add prevention instruction to user_prompt; flag blank prevention.
Render mistakes in status text and audit text.
Add mistakes report to athena audit output and JSON; update help text if categories are listed.
Verify unknown-category message lists mistake; adjust only if hard-coded.
Only if an exhaustive match or category list needs the new variant.
Tests for mistake introspection, prompt, and repeat-cause aggregation.
Tests: mistake accepted, bogus rejected, status/audit counts, record bytes unchanged.
Document the category, prefix rule and the mistake report.
Record the change and its root cause.

steps: records.rs: add variant, ALL [..;9], as_str, Intervention::is_mistake() with doc comment, and unit tests.
Fix every exhaustive match flagged by cargo check, including reading.rs and the manage.rs message.

status.rs: add MistakeReport and builder; cause = failure-class of newest recorded introspection for the intervention id, else 'not yet introspected'; add `mistakes` to StatusView and a public method for audit; unit test.
introspect.rs: effective category 'mistake' in event_of_intervention; prompt instruction; blank-prevention flag; schema unchanged.
display.rs and main.rs: render the report in status text, audit text and audit JSON, marking recurring causes.
Write tests in introspection.rs and lifecycle.rs with the stub model.
Run cargo fmt --all, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: An existing test asserting the ALL length or category counts breaks.
risks.mitigation: Grep for ALL and interventions_by_category usage and update expectations; the raw map is unchanged.

risks.risk: Model assigns inconsistent failure classes, splitting repeats.
risks.mitigation: The prompt offers the class registry and earlier cases; un-introspected mistakes are listed apart, never guessed.

risks.risk: Existing introspections of prefix-marked records have category 'other'.
risks.mitigation: Link mistakes to introspections by intervention id, not category string.
Print the mistakes block only when total > 0, one line per cause.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in records.rs (parse mistake, ALL has it, length 9) and lifecycle.rs tests: intervene with category mistake succeeds; category bogus fails with an error listing mistake.
demonstrations.observes: New tests pass: mistake accepted by parser and ALL; bogus rejected with a message that lists mistake.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the Mistake variant parse returns None, intervene is refused, and the rejection list omits mistake, so the tests fail.

demonstrations.method: lifecycle.rs and status.rs tests log several mistakes (one category mistake, one other with 'Mistake:' text) across two classes and two causes; read status --json and audit output with a stub model; assert mistakes.total, by_class, by_cause, and that interventions_by_category is separate and unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: Per-class and per-cause counts appear in status JSON, status text and audit output.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the report the mistakes key is missing and the lookups fail.

demonstrations.method: introspection.rs test with stub model: introspect a mistake, assert stored record has prevention_kind and non-empty prevention and proposed_request, and the prompt contains the mistake instruction; two mistakes sharing a failure class yield one cause entry with count 2 and one proposal.
demonstrations.observes: A mistake introspection names the preventing check or knowledge; repeat causes appear as one entry with one proposal.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without mistake handling the prompt lacks the instruction and category stays other; without aggregation two entries appear.

demonstrations.method: Test seeds a category-other intervention with 'Mistake:' text, asserts status JSON and audit count it, and compares record file bytes before and after. The is_mistake doc comment states the prefix rule.
demonstrations.observes: The prefix-marked record is counted as a mistake and its file is byte-identical.
demonstrations.fails_without: A category-only check counts zero for back-filled records and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Run the formatter check and the lint check as separate whole commands; each exits nonzero on any diagnostic.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy exits 0 with no warnings; run `cargo fmt --check` as well, which exits 0 with no diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the new code were unformatted, `cargo fmt --check` would print a diff and exit nonzero; if it had an unused variant, non-exhaustive handling, needless clones or similar, clippy with -D warnings would exit nonzero.

demonstrations.method: Tests for criteria 2 and 3 assert on rendered status and audit text: total mistakes, per-class and per-cause counts, recurring causes marked, a line per cause with prevention kind and text, or 'not yet introspected' with the introspect command.
demonstrations.observes: Rendered output shows how many mistakes occurred, which classes and causes recur, and the proposed prevention.
demonstrations.fails_without: A type-only change leaves rendered output unchanged and these assertions fail.

open_questions: Is 'the audit' `athena audit`? Assumed yes as the only audit command; the report is repository-wide.
reading.rs and manage.rs were not read in full; the producer should confirm whether they need edits.
Where the introspection system prompt lives was not checked; keep the instruction in user_prompt unless clearer elsewhere.
Job-less mistakes never reach proposals.rs; whether to feed them into defaults proposals is a later decision.
